{{Top|leg}}
'''Heller''' was an individual who owned a suit of [[Cresh Luck armor/Legends|Cresh Luck armor]]. Heller modified the default alarm system of the armor using the "[[tingler]]" of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]&mdash;commonly used to warn of an almost empty magazine&mdash;. Instead of warning of proximity attacks through a noise, the armor did so with a subtle "tingle".

Reading about the problems of the Cresh Luck armor's noise on a post by [[Jatras]] in [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]], Heller replied posting his suggestion.
